arguments.name: con
arguments.text: Required, and unused for the quoting rules.

origin.details: Values in .x are quoted the same way as in glue_sql.
origin.example:
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), ":memory:")
cat(as.character(glue_data_sql(list(name = "O'Malley"), "INSERT {name}", .con = con)), "\n", sep = "")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

translation.description: glue_data with the same RSQLite quoting as glue_sql.

arguments.name: con
arguments.text: Required, and unused for the quoting rules.

translation.details: A string value is single-quoted and an apostrophe is doubled.
translation.example:
from glue import glue_data_sql, sqlite
print(glue_data_sql({"name": "O'Malley"}, "INSERT {name}", con=sqlite, envir={}))
